content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect usage of the `group.sort` option in the `TopGroupsResultTransformer` class, where the wrong variable (`groupSort`) was passed to the `transformToNativeShardDoc` method instead of the correct variable (`sortWithinGroup`). This led to improper sorting of grouped results in distributed queries, affecting the expected output when sorting was applied. The patch corrected this by ensuring the appropriate sorting variable was used, thus fixing the sorting behavior in grouped query results.

Code statements:
```java
ScoreDoc[] scoreDocs = transformToNativeShardDoc(documents, groupSort, shard, schema);
```
